findings.title: Favor makes the route socially traceable
findings.claim: The requested road becomes a route that can be recognized in the lives of those who have received favor.
findings.mechanism: The focus road carrier meets the focus bestowal carrier, while the external favored-company and remembered-deliverance passages provide a wider social and historical trigger; the road is therefore read through embodied recipients rather than as an unlocated abstraction.
findings.reader_payoff: The road acquires a visible human trace without losing its ordinary guidance sense.
findings.containment: The finding concerns how this road is made traceable through favored recipients; it does not define every favored person or every use of road language.

epistemic.reason: The focus-anchored publication is trusted, while the corroborating reader-walk material is legacy_unbound and the wider connection rows remain discovery nominations.

branch_activations.carrier: صِرَٰطَ carries the route on which movement proceeds.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 4:69 and 14:6 present favored recipients as an identifiable company and a community carried through deliverance.
branch_activations.activation: When the focus road meets these wider recipient and deliverance scenes, a route can be recognized through the people who have received and embodied it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The requested road appears as a socially traceable and historically lived route.
branch_activations.boundary: The road remains the guidance route named by the focus; no claim is made that every historical group is a complete exemplar.

branch_activations.activation: Bestowal meeting an embodied recipient makes the favor a trace that can be followed in a community's course.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Those favored function as living evidence of where the requested road can be found.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a traceability relation between favor and the road, not a claim that favor is reduced to social status.

findings.title: Favor carries the traveler onward

findings.mechanism: The focus road supplies movement, while the two focus favor facets supply ease and intensification; the external favor-as-care and straight-path passages independently return those operations to the route.
findings.reader_payoff: Favor becomes active support for passage rather than a stationary possession.
findings.containment: The reading adds a movement and support dimension to bestowed favor while preserving the plain claim that favor was granted to the recipients.

epistemic.reason: The core publication is trusted and the route-softening elaboration is legacy_unbound; external connection rows are corroborating nominations.

branch_activations.activation: Ease in the favor word meets the road's onward movement, so support becomes something that makes travel livable.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recipients are carried through a route whose resistance has been softened.
branch_activations.boundary: The image concerns enabling favor in this route relation; it does not turn every comfort into guidance.

findings.containment: The boundary qualifies the requested road and its excluded relations; it does not erase the ordinary class distinction named by the ayah.

friction_notes: The global packet has no selected context-unit projections. Wider activation therefore uses supplied inter-surah connection rows, whose target Arabic is present but whose target morphology is not; their notes are treated as discovery evidence rather than inherited decisions.

Several candidate branches are nominated outside the focus and have no valid focus or selected-context carrier occurrence. Each such branch is explicitly excluded in the owning narrow or rejected decision.

The ten assigned HFT records are legacy_unbound and unanchored reader summaries. They provide no exact word index, root, attributed role, and focus-return trace, so they are reviewed and rejected without suppressing the separately anchored candidate readings.

Reader-walk evidence remains qualified because its source identity is legacy_unbound. Trusted cross-run publications provide direct focus anchors where cited, while external connections remain qualified wider triggers.

Every supplied candidate was reviewed exactly once; represented decisions point only to findings that retain the candidate's complete branch set. No additional negative inventory was created for unlinked branches.
